description: This file contains unit tests for the USB device interface, including event handling, device list retrieval, driver binding/unbinding, and device info queries, using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks.

classes.name: AsyncHandlerMock_USBDevice
classes.description: Mock class for handling asynchronous USB device events, with methods for plugged in and out events, using Google Mock.

classes.name: USBDeviceNotificationHandler
classes.description: Implementation of the IUSBDevice notification interface, handling device plugged in/out events, synchronization, and waiting for specific events.

classes.name: USBDeviceTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for USB device tests, managing setup, teardown, mocks, and helper functions for testing USB device interactions.

methods.name: USBDeviceTest()
methods.description: Constructor initializing mocks, registering callbacks, and activating the USB device service.

methods.name: ~USBDeviceTest()
methods.description: Destructor deregistering callbacks and deactivating the service.

methods.name: WaitForRequestStatus
methods.description: Waits for a specific device event (plugged in/out) within a timeout period.

methods.name: Mock_SetDeviceDesc
methods.description: Mocks setting device descriptor details based on bus number, device address, and class.

methods.name: Mock_SetSerialNumberInUSBDevicePath
methods.description: Mocks setting serial number files for devices.

methods.name: CreateUSBDeviceInterfaceObjectUsingComRPCConnection
methods.description: Creates a USB device interface object via COM RPC connection for testing.
